payload.claim: The summary's 'past the token-diff bound' caveat is built with `', '.join(estimated)`, which does correctly name every file past the bound when there is more than one — but no test in this diff ever puts two files past the bound in the same diff. `test_a_file_past_the_token_diff_bound_is_estimated_from_its_changed_lines`'s sixth case pairs the one estimated file with a second file that is diffed exactly, never with a second estimated one. Replacing `', '.join(estimated)` with `estimated[0]` (naming only the first oversized file and silently dropping the rest) keeps every existing test green, because none of them exercises the multi-file case the spec's own item 1 claims ('the summary names each such file, as it names an unreadable one').
